review.title: My recommendations.
review.review1: Very precise and leaving nothing to chance, Adrien's work shows a real willingness to find solutions and solve problems down to the smallest detail, while making an effort to maintain his level of knowledge and expertise at the highest level. Adrien is very attentive to every detail of a project. Add to that his excellent interpersonal skills, and you've got the makings of a real pleasure. A real pleasure.
review.review2: Adrien has worked on several projects within the Postal IS office of the Office des Postes et Télécommunications de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. As a SCRUM Master, I appreciated his versatility and the fact that he always volunteered to help the various team members. He was also very involved in the design of the applications, which were tastefully developed and very much appreciated by the users. On a human level, he integrated very quickly and contributed greatly to the good atmosphere within the team. I highly recommend him.
review.review3: Adrien joined our development team on two projects combining Angular, SpringBoot and Ionic technologies.Very concerned with the UI and UX aspects of his applications, he knows how to provide effective and relevant design solutions.His affinity for Agile methodology has enabled him to take on the role of Scrum Master on several occasions. A role he fulfilled with unfailing professionalism for part of the project.On the human side, Adrien integrated very easily into the team and played an important role in its cohesion. He's an extrovert who tends to bring team members together.

intro.title: My work.
intro.subtitle: I help B2B SaaS go from MVP to production. Here is a selection of projects I have worked on.

design.title: Design is part of the craft.
design.subtitle: The eye matters as much as the code: my business card, fully rebuilt in animated HTML/CSS.

ogmah.title: OGMAH
ogmah.description: B2B foodtech SaaS for restaurant cost optimization. Centralizes recipes, stock, orders and margins, powered by predictive AI (sales, order and stock forecasting). Measured impact: −15% waste, −25% admin, +7% margins.

case.headline: Giving restaurant owners back control of their margins with AI.
case.need: In the food business, margins are won by the cent: recipes, stock, orders and supplier prices often live in scattered spreadsheets with no real-time view. Restaurant owners needed a single tool to manage the economics of their business straight from their recipes.
case.solution: As co-founder and CTO, I co-built the platform from scratch, iterating constantly with chefs and restaurant owners: architecture, tech choices, development and production. AI sits at the core of the product to automate economic decisions.

points.1: Full SaaS platform: recipe sheets, stock, orders, margins and production planning
points.2: Predictive AI: sales forecasting, predictive ordering and stock projections
points.3: Short iterations with users — every feature serves a precise business goal

case.results: Measured results across user establishments: −15% food waste, −25% admin time and +7% margins. The product is live and keeps evolving.

vgp.title: Offline-first VGP app
vgp.description: Mobile app for regulatory inspections (periodic statutory checks) of lifting equipment. Technicians manage field interventions even without connectivity, syncing as soon as the network is back.

case.headline: Reliable statutory inspections, even with no signal.
case.need: UPTIME, a software agency in Cesson-Sévigné, needed to equip technicians performing statutory inspections (VGP) of lifting equipment: field work on sites where connectivity is never guaranteed, with strict regulatory traceability.
case.solution: Reinforcing the team through Neodev Consulting, I built a mobile app designed offline-first: data lives on the device first and syncs to the back-end as soon as the network is available.

points.1: Offline-first: local SQLite storage with automatic back-end sync
points.2: Secure authentication and full field-intervention management
points.3: Modern shared stack: React Native on mobile, NestJS server-side

case.results: Technicians no longer depend on the network: inspections are recorded on site and consolidated automatically — no re-entry, no data loss.

sante.title: Field healthcare platform
sante.description: Digital solution for healthcare professionals to manage medical interventions in the field.

case.headline: Structuring medical case management in the field.
case.need: Aexmed builds a digital solution for healthcare professionals managing medical interventions in the field. The team needed reinforcement to grow the platform and streamline case workflows.
case.solution: Through Neodev Consulting, I contributed to the platform's key workflows: from case creation to the final report, including questionnaires, appointment scheduling and invoicing.

points.1: Complete case workflow: creation, questionnaire, appointment, report, invoicing
points.2: Web and mobile apps sharing one NestJS back-end
points.3: Team collaboration with Aexmed and Neodev developers

case.results: A platform that structures professionals' daily work: every case follows a clear path from first contact to invoice.

integrale.title: NOMADE / INTEGRALE tech leadership
integrale.description: Led the technical strategy (roadmap, R&D, audits, CI/CD) and the development team for NOMADE (Madagascar) and INTEGRALE (Réunion).

case.headline: Building the technical leadership of two companies, between Réunion and Madagascar.
case.need: INTEGRALE Ingénierie (Réunion) and NOMADE (Madagascar) needed technical leadership: roadmap, technology choices, software quality and upskilling a team of developers.
case.solution: As Director of Innovation (CTO), I defined and executed the technical strategy: a roadmap aligned with business goals, audits to reduce technical debt, industrialized deliveries and team coaching.

points.1: Technology roadmap aligned with business objectives
points.2: CI/CD, automated testing and scalability best practices

case.results: A structured, autonomous team, industrialized deliveries, and regular KPI reporting bringing transparency between leadership, business teams and contractors.

opt-sido.title: SIDO Mobile — parcel delivery
opt-sido.description: Mobile mail and parcel delivery app for OPT: parcel scanning and on-site customer signature capture.

case.headline: Digitizing parcel delivery across New Caledonia.
case.need: New Caledonia's post and telecom office (OPT) wanted to streamline parcel delivery: scanning parcels and capturing proof of delivery in the field, replacing paper processes.
case.solution: Working within the postal IS office through Skazy NC, I built the SIDO MOBILE app used by delivery agents: parcel scanning, route tracking and customer signature capture on delivery.

points.1: Parcel scanning and route tracking on the move
points.2: Customer signature captured directly on mobile
points.3: Ionic/Angular app backed by Spring Boot

case.results: End-to-end traceability for OPT agents — and no more paper slips at delivery.

opt-portail.title: OPT customer portal & tools
opt-portail.description: Internet-facing customer portal, internal billing tools and post-office tools, with unified OpenID (OKTA) authentication.

case.headline: Unifying online access to postal services.
case.need: OPT wanted to give customers fast, convenient online access to its services while equipping internal teams: billing, post-office operations and unified authentication across the IS.
case.solution: Within the postal IS office (through Skazy NC), I contributed to the public customer portal, internal billing tools and post-office tools, implementing centralized OpenID authentication with OKTA.

points.2: Customer portal exposed on the internet
points.3: Internal tools: billing and post-office operations

case.results: Simpler customer access, leaner billing processes and consistent authentication across applications.

cafat.title: CAFAT customer portals
cafat.description: Customer portals to track New Caledonia's social-security healthcare system.

case.headline: Simplifying healthcare procedures for New Caledonians.
case.need: CAFAT — New Caledonia's social security — wanted customer portals making the healthcare system easier to track for insured members and professionals.
case.solution: Through ISI.NC, I helped build the customer portals: Angular interfaces backed by Spring Boot services, integrated with the organisation's information system.

points.1: Customer portals for the healthcare system
points.3: Angular + Spring Boot, alongside CAFAT's developers

case.results: Easier online procedures for members, fewer manual tasks for the teams.

obs.title: Orange Business Services tools
obs.description: Cross-device tooling (desktop, mobile, tablet) for Orange Business Services, with REST APIs for application integration and interoperability.

case.headline: Tools available everywhere for Orange Business Services teams.
case.need: Orange Business Services needed a range of internal tools accessible from any device — desktop, mobile, tablet — available both internally and over the internet.
case.solution: At Capgemini (Rennes), I designed and built these cross-device tools, using REST APIs for integration and interoperability between applications, while serving as back-up Scrum Master.

points.1: Responsive tools across desktop, mobile and tablet
points.2: REST APIs for application integration and interoperability
points.3: Back-up Scrum Master: agile facilitation and team coordination

case.results: Tools available wherever the teams need them, inside and outside the company.

freelance-nc.title: Apps & brand identities
freelance-nc.description: Neumorphic Flutter mobile app, several websites (HTML/CSS/Angular) and digital brand identities (logos, visuals).

case.headline: Giving two New Caledonian businesses a digital identity.
case.need: Kalikom and Santé O Global, two Nouméa businesses, needed to exist online: apps, websites and a consistent visual identity, from scratch.
case.solution: As a freelancer I handled it end to end: a neumorphic Flutter mobile app, custom websites (HTML/CSS/Angular) and full digital identities — logos, brand assets and social media material.

points.3: Complete visual identity: logos, covers and ad visuals

case.results: Two brands visible online with a consistent identity from logo to social feeds.
